record.source_text: Player A's statement is true if either at least two of A and B are knaves or A and B have the same role. Since A is knight (always true), at least one holds. Player B's statement denies 'at least 0 of A and F are spies' which is false since zero or more is true, so B lies, hence knave. Player C claims 'not at most 1 spy among five players'; since only one spy exists, this is false, so C lies, knave. Player D claims B and C differ; since B and C are both knaves, this is false; D lies or tells truth? D must be spy to satisfy only one spy. Player E denies A is knight; since A is knight, E's statement is false, so E lies. But only one spy allowed; so E must be knight telling truth. F's statement about at most 2 knights among C, D, E, F holds with the assignments. Thus roles assigned consistently.
